title: Final Research Presentation Rehearsal
objective: Students combine story, slides, voice, graph language, and Q&A into a complete presentation.
outcomes: Respond to at least two questions.
activity: Rehearsal day: present for 5-7 minutes, receive peer feedback, revise one slide and one answer.
example: A final talk on plant growth includes background, objective, methods, one graph, conclusion, limitation, and future research.
